source.heading: Start with your lesson material
source.copy: Paste a passage or upload what you teach from — PDF, Word, slides, or a photo of a page. The plan is always shown for review before slides are generated.
source.panelCopy: Use your own words, or upload text and images you have the right to use.
source.suggested: Suggested from the document text — edit it if you like.
source.suggestEmpty: Add a file or paste text so a title can be suggested.
source.dropNote: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, TXT or photos (PNG, JPG) · 8 files max · 10 MB each
source.filesHelp: Files are read in the order shown and combined into one source. Every file is deleted with the draft after approval.
source.pastePlaceholder: Paste the passage, outline, or topic you want to teach…
source.textHelp: Keep it focused. Long documents are truncated after 30,000 characters.
source.attestation: I confirm these files and this text contain no student names, emails, photos of students, or other personal information.
source.attestationLocked: The material is locked because the plan is already built. Start a new draft to change it.
source.setupCopy: These guide the level and length of the generated lesson.
source.subject: Subject
source.costNote: The larger slide cost is quoted after you review and edit the plan.
source.exampleText:
The Bill of Rights is the first ten amendments to the United States Constitution. It protects individual freedoms and limits the power of the federal government.

The First Amendment protects five freedoms: religion, speech, press, assembly, and the right to petition the government. The Fourth Amendment protects people from unreasonable searches and seizures. The Fifth Amendment guarantees due process and protects people from self-incrimination. The Sixth Amendment guarantees the right to a speedy and public trial.
source.modeHighHint: One slide per call. Clearer pages, a little slower.
source.modeLowHint: Writes the batch in one call. Quicker, pages may repeat.
source.setupLocked: The plan is built, so these settings are locked. Start a new draft to change them.

plan.heading: Review the plan
plan.copy: Everything is editable. Questions stay in sequence with the slides around them; nothing is generated until you approve the outline.
plan.panelCopy: Drag or use the arrow buttons to reorder.
plan.matchesBody: You asked for {{slides}} teaching slides and {{questions}} questions. Changes you make after this point are allowed.
plan.noMatchBody: You asked for {{slides}} teaching slides and {{questions}} questions. Your edits are what will be generated.
plan.beforeStrong: Nothing is saved as a lesson yet.
plan.beforeBody: Approval happens after every slide is generated and reviewed.
plan.regenLimit: This draft has used all its plan regenerations.

slides.heading: Review slides
slides.copy: Teaching slides are designed by the app and questions use the native renderer. Edit the text, enhance one slide at a time, or leave and come back later.
slides.captionNote: Speaker notes and question answers stay teacher-only
slides.noNotes: No speaker notes for this slide.
slides.enhanceCopy: Keep the lesson moving without losing the source.
slides.pauseStrong: Generation runs while this page is open.
slides.pauseBody: If you leave, finished slides are saved and you can resume.
slides.approveHint: All slides must be ready before approval.
slides.empty: Choose a slide from the list to preview it.

failure.ITEM_MISSING: The AI skipped this slide. Retry it.
failure.LANGUAGE_MISMATCH: The AI wrote this slide in the wrong language. Retry it.
failure.ITEM_EDITED: This slide changed while the AI was writing it. Reload to see the latest version.

slides.staleSlide: The plan changed; regenerate this item.
slides.matchingHint: Match each term with its pair.
slides.orderingHint: Put the steps in the correct order.
slides.stopHint: You can stop after the current group of slides finishes.

approve.heading: Approve and save
approve.copy: Add the finished lesson to your library. Students will not see it until you start a live session.
approve.heroCopy: The draft passed the final checks. Review the lesson one last time.
approve.checkKeysBody: Multiple-choice, true/false and multi-select answers pass validation.
approve.checkPlanBody: No slide was edited after the final review.
approve.checkSafeBody: No HTML, external images or scripts are attached.
approve.warnBody: Finish generating every slide before saving.
approve.contractBody: This becomes a normal Live Lesson. You can edit it, share it, move it between years, or start a session whenever you are ready. Uploaded files and source text are removed from the draft after saving.
approve.formCopy: Choose the class that should see this lesson.
approve.subject: Subject
approve.title: Lesson title
approve.descriptionPlaceholder: A short note for your library
approve.checkboxStrong: I checked the questions and answers.
approve.checkboxBody: AI can make mistakes. Review the lesson before students see it.
approve.readyLineBody: Saved as a normal Live Lesson
approve.readyHint: You can change the title, class, or content later from the lesson library.
approve.successBody: It is in your library and ready for a live session.
approve.notReady: Finish generating every slide before saving.
approve.needChecked: Confirm that you checked the questions and answers.

footer.sourceBody: Add your material and review the plan first
footer.sourceHint: Nothing is saved as a lesson until you approve it.
footer.planHint: You can edit any row before generating. Nothing is saved as a lesson yet.
footer.slidesBodyReady: Review the lesson before saving it
footer.approveBody: Saved as a normal Live Lesson
footer.approveHint: You can change the title, class, or content later from the lesson library.

item.copy: Set the title and brief. Content is generated later.
item.title: Title
item.briefPlaceholder: What should students do or learn here?

slide.copy: Changes are saved to this draft only. The lesson is not published.
slide.aiCopy: Editing text only. The design, colors and layout stay as generated.
slide.slotRequired: Every text field on the slide needs a value.
slide.title: Title
slide.examplesHint: One example per line. At least two.
slide.notesHint: Teacher only. Use this to guide the lesson.
slide.requiredExamples: An examples slide needs at least two examples.
slide.requiredPrompt: A question needs a question body.
slide.requiredOptions: A question needs at least two options and one correct answer.
slide.requiredOptionsMulti: Pick at least two correct answers.
slide.matchingHint: Each term matches one answer, and a term can only appear once.
slide.requiredPairs: A matching question needs at least two complete pairs.
slide.duplicateTerm: Each term can only appear once.
slide.orderingHint: List the steps in the order students should put them.
slide.requiredSteps: An ordering question needs at least three steps.
slide.blanksHint: Write each blank in the question as {{b1}}. Separate the wordings a student may use with ~.
slide.missingBlank: Add a blank to the question first.
slide.requiredBlankAnswers: Every blank needs at least one accepted answer.
slide.requiredNumericRange: Enter the lowest and highest value for the range.
slide.wordOrder: The minimum word count cannot be above the maximum.
slide.writtenHint: Written answers are graded by you on the review page, never automatically.

enhance.title: Enhance this slide
enhance.copy: Pick a direction and add a note. The slide keeps its place in the lesson.
enhance.instructionPlaceholder: e.g. Use a simpler example for Grade 5.
enhance.keepText: Keep the current text and only add to it
enhance.limit: This slide has used all {{max}} regenerations.
enhance.needInput: Pick a direction or write what should change.

settings.aiBuilderCopy: When enabled, teachers can paste material or upload files and let AI draft a live lesson. The plan is always reviewed before slides are generated, and every generated lesson is saved as a normal Live Lesson.

help.title: How the builder works
help.body1: Add the material you teach from, then review and edit the generated outline. Nothing is generated until you approve that outline.
help.body2: Slides are written in small groups. You can edit any slide, enhance one at a time, or leave and resume later.
help.body3: Every generated lesson is saved as a normal Live Lesson in your library. Uploaded files and source text are deleted from the draft after saving.
help.body4: AI can make mistakes. Check the questions and answers before students see the lesson.

errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.VALIDATION: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.DRAFT_NOT_FOUND: This draft was not found. It may have expired or been discarded.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: This draft changed in another tab. Reload before saving.
errors.REV_CONFLICT: This item changed in another tab. Reload before saving your edit.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: That action was already sent with different details. Try again.
errors.OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS: Another AI step is still running for this draft. Wait for it to finish.
errors.PLAN_EXISTS: A plan already exists for this draft.
errors.PLAN_REQUIRED: Generate the plan before editing its items.
errors.PLAN_COUNT_MISMATCH: The plan did not match the requested counts. Try generating it again.
errors.AI_CREDIT_REQUIRED: There is not enough AI credit for this step. Top up and resume; finished slides stay saved.
errors.ITEMS_NOT_READY: Some items still need content before this step.
errors.REGEN_LIMIT: This item or draft has reached its regeneration limit.
errors.SOURCE_LOCKED: The plan is already built from this material. Start a new draft to change the source.
errors.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The source material is no longer held in memory and no browser copy matched this lesson. Upload the document again to continue; slides that already have content are kept.
errors.SOURCE_MISMATCH: The saved browser copy no longer matches this lesson. Upload the document again to continue.
errors.SOURCE_RESTORE_INCOMPLETE: The saved browser copy is incomplete. Upload the document again to continue.
errors.SOURCE_NOT_VOLATILE: This draft keeps its source in the database, so there is nothing to restore.
errors.ATTESTATION_REQUIRED: Confirm that the material contains no student personal information.
errors.MODEL_UNPRICED: The AI model has no configured price, so the builder cannot run.
errors.AI_BUILDER_DISABLED: The AI lesson builder is turned off for your school.
errors.FEATURE_DISABLED: This feature is not available right now.
errors.AI_JSON_INVALID: The AI reply could not be read. Try the step again.
errors.CONTENT_INVALID: One or more items could not be read. Fix them before continuing.
errors.LANGUAGE_MISMATCH: The generated content did not match the lesson language. Try again.
errors.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The lesson is above the builder limits.
errors.AI_FAILED: The AI step failed. Finished slides stay saved; try again.
errors.APPROVE_FAILED: The lesson could not be saved. Reload and try again.
errors.ITEM_EDITED: An item changed while the AI was writing it. Reload to see the latest version.
errors.ITEM_MISSING: The AI skipped this item. Retry it.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: One file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FILE: One file type is not supported.
